text_en: In those days Hezekiah became sick and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “Thus says the Lord : Set your house in order, for you shall die; you shall not recover. ”
text_cn: 在那些日子内，希则克雅患病垂危，阿摩兹的儿子依撒意亚来看他，对他说：“上主这样说：快料理你的家务，因为你快要死，不能久活了。”

text_en: Then Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord :
text_cn: 希则克雅就转面向墙，恳求上主说：

text_en: “Remember now, O Lord , I implore you, how I have walked before you in faithfulness with a whole heart, and have done what is good in your sight. ” Hezekiah wept bitterly.
text_cn: “上主，求你记忆我如何怀着忠诚齐全的心，在你面前行走；如何作了你视为正义的事。”然后希则克雅放声大哭。

text_en: Before Isaiah had gone out of the middle court, the word of the Lord came to him:
text_cn: 依撒意亚出来，还没有走到中院，上主的话传于他说：

text_en: “Turn back, and say to Hezekiah prince of my people, Thus says the Lord , the God of your ancestor David: I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears; indeed, I will heal you; on the third day you shall go up to the house of the Lord .
text_cn: “你回去，告诉我人民的领袖希则克雅说：上主，你祖先达味的天主这样说：我听见了你的祈祷，看见了你的眼泪。看，我必要治好你，第三天你就能上上主的殿。

text_en: I will add fifteen years to your life. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; I will defend this city for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake. ”
text_cn: 我要在你的寿数上多加十五年，且由亚述王手中拯救你和这座城；为了我自己和我的仆人达味，我必保护这座城。”

text_en: Then Isaiah said, “Bring a lump of figs. Let them take it and apply it to the boil, so that he may recover. ”
text_cn: 依撒意亚遂吩咐说：“拿一块无花果饼来。”人就拿来，贴在疮口上；君王就好了。

text_en: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of the Lord on the third day? ”
text_cn: 希则克雅对依撒意亚说：“有什么征兆，上主要治好我，第三天我就能上上主的殿？”

text_en: Isaiah said, “This is the sign to you from the Lord , that the Lord will do the thing that he has promised: the shadow has now advanced ten intervals; shall it retreat ten intervals? ”
text_cn: 依撒意亚回答说：“这就是上主给你的征兆，上主必实践他所说的话：你要日影向前进十度，还是要往后退十度？”

text_en: Hezekiah answered, “It is normal for the shadow to lengthen ten intervals; rather let the shadow retreat ten intervals. ”
text_cn: 希则克雅答说：“日影向前进十度太容易，我不要；我要日影，倒退十度。”

text_en: The prophet Isaiah cried to the Lord ; and he brought the shadow back the ten intervals, by which the sun had declined on the dial of Ahaz.
text_cn: 先知依撒意亚呼求上主，上主就使射在阿哈次日晷（guǐ）上的日影倒退了十度。

text_en: At that time King Merodach-baladan son of Baladan of Babylon sent envoys with letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
text_cn: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉丹的儿子默洛达客、巴拉丹派人来见希则克雅，呈上书信和礼物，因为他听说希则克雅患病又好了。

text_en: Hezekiah welcomed them; he showed them all his treasure house, the silver, the gold, the spices, the precious oil, his armory, all that was found in his storehouses; there was nothing in his house or in all his realm that Hezekiah did not show them.
text_cn: 希则克雅非常高兴，就叫使者参观自己的宝库、金银、香料、珍膏和武器库，以及他府库内所有的财宝：凡他宫中和全国内所有的，希则克雅没有一样不叫他们不看的。

text_en: Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you? ” Hezekiah answered, “They have come from a far country, from Babylon. ”
text_cn: 依撒意亚先知遂来见希则克雅，对他说：“这些人说了什么？他们是从什么地方到你这里来的？”希则克雅回答说：“他们是从远方，从巴比伦来的。”

text_en: He said, “What have they seen in your house? ” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house; there is nothing in my storehouses that I did not show them. ”
text_cn: 先知又问说：“他们在你宫中看见了什么？”希则克雅回答说：“凡我宫中所有的，他们都看了；凡我府库内所有的，没有一样我不叫他们不看的。”

text_en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the word of the Lord :
text_cn: 依撒意亚遂对希则克雅说：“你听上主的话吧！

text_en: Days are coming when all that is in your house, and that which your ancestors have stored up until this day, shall be carried to Babylon; nothing shall be left, says the Lord .
text_cn: 日子要到，凡你宫中所有的，及你祖先直到今日所积蓄的，都要被带到巴比伦去，什么也不会留下：上主说。

text_en: Some of your own sons who are born to you shall be taken away; they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon. ”
text_cn: 此外，由你所出，即你所生的子孙中，也有一些要被掳去，在巴比伦王宫内充当太监。

text_en: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The word of the Lord that you have spoken is good. ” For he thought, “Why not, if there will be peace and security in my days? ”
text_cn: 希则克雅对依撒意亚说：“你所说的上主的话是合理的！”继而说：“惟愿我有生之日有平安，有安全！”

text_en: The rest of the deeds of Hezekiah, all his power, how he made the pool and the conduit and brought water into the city, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Judah?
text_cn: 希则克雅其余的事迹，他的英勇和他怎样凿池筑沟，引水入城的事，都记载在《犹大列王实录》上。

text_en: Hezekiah slept with his ancestors; and his son Manasseh succeeded him.
text_cn: 希则克雅与他的列祖同眠，他的儿子默纳舍继位为王。
